context: 2.16.1 Task 3: argv dispatch extracted to src/cli/dispatch.ts; unknown non-flag word exits 2 with usage instead of booting the stdio server; validate-records wired into index.ts; README + UPGRADE-v2 docs
rationale: resolveProjectRoot reads only --project and no supported invocation places a bare word at argv[2] (launch-server.sh execs pass flags or nothing), so refusing at that one position closes the cron/launchd footgun (twining-mcp drain booting a server) with zero change to every existing flag-first invocation; --version/-v keep their pre-dispatch handling
summary: Chose to classify only argv[2] (undefined or flag-first = server; known word = subcommand with argv.slice(3); any other word = refused exit 2) over a full argv parser
